'''Michael Girard Recurring Mains(Drazin)''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Michael Girard]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-941">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/941 Recurring Mains(Drazin)], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 21 October 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/941/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/941/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018223933/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/941/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Girard]]
* '''Published:''' 21 October 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Recurring Mains(Drazin)''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor CCT Girard DS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is a strong deck that works around recurring mains and toys and taking care of the light side mains.  has side strategies for force loss.

== Original post ==

'''Recurring Mains(Drazin)'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Dvader" Girard
* '''Published:''' October 21, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is a strong deck that works around recurring mains and toys and taking care of the light side mains.  has side strategies for force loss.

=== Strategy ===

This is probably the best balanced recurring mains drazin deck that can be made.	It covers all the basics for counters.	the we have a prisoners are anti-noble sacrifice tech so you can get another captive to continue recurring.  the occupation is another form of damage for stuff like numbers and other non-interactive decks.  this deck is solid.
